verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance's registered agent service says clients receive critical legal documents electronically and are notified by phone when service of process arrives. That directly delivers an immediate alert for lawsuits rather than a batched mail cycle. The public OpenAPI spec also exposes registered-agent-deliveries endpoints, which corroborates electronic delivery records. Missing for 10: any documented notification timing or SLA, explicit coverage of time-sensitive notices other than service of process, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond a single marketing line.
